item_short_desc: Rothco’s Deluxe Marching Compass is a versatile and reliable navigation tool, perfect for outdoor enthusiasts, hikers, survivalists, and explorers. Encased in a durable zinc alloy case, this survival compass is designed to withstand the elements and ensure long-lasting use. The camping compass features a fluorescent green north arrow for easy visibility in low light conditions, along with a 360-degree circular scale and inclination scale to provide precise navigation. A side ruler allows you to measure distances on your map accurately.
description: Rothco’s Deluxe Marching Compass is a versatile and reliable navigation tool, perfect for outdoor enthusiasts, hikers, survivalists, and explorers. Encased in a durable zinc alloy case, this survival compass is designed to withstand the elements and ensure long-lasting use. The camping compass features a fluorescent green north arrow for easy visibility in low light conditions, along with a 360-degree circular scale and inclination scale to provide precise navigation. A side ruler allows you to measure distances on your map accurately, while the built-in magnifier and level enhance the compass's functionality. Whether you're navigating through dense forests or open fields, Rothco’s Deluxe Marching Compass ensures you stay on course with confidence.
